claim.claim-text: 1. A cap for a beverage pod, the cap comprising:
a gas inlet port in fluid communication with the piercing element.
2. The cap of claim 1, wherein a centerline of the lumen is offset from a centerline of the piercing element.
3. The cap of claim 1, wherein the piercing element includes a side port in fluid communication with the gas inlet port.
4. The cap of claim 3, wherein the cap further comprises a gas inlet port fluidically coupled with the side port and arranged to deliver pressurized gas into an internal space of the container.

5. The cap of claim 1, further comprising a drip ledge extending from a bottom wall of the piston, the drip ledge defining an aperture in fluid communication with the lumen and being configured to direct beverage medium from the lumen toward a beverage machine.
6. A beverage pod for a beverage machine, the beverage pod comprising:
7. The beverage pod of claim 6, wherein the gasket engages each of the container, the plug, and the cap.
8. The beverage pod of claim 6, wherein:
the gasket is positioned between the plug and the container; and the cap engages at least a portion of the plug.
9. The beverage pod of claim 8, wherein the cap is integrated with the beverage pod to compress the gasket between the plug and the container.
10. The beverage pod of claim 6, wherein the gasket is configured to maintain the internal space at a pressure above an ambient pressure surrounding the beverage pod.
11. The beverage pod of claim 10, wherein:
the plug includes an annular plug flange; and the gasket is positioned between the plug flange of the plug and a container flange of the container.
12. The beverage pod of claim 11, wherein the gasket engages the container, the plug, and the cap.
